en: Colorized historic postcard showing an industrial complex with tall factory chimneys by a riverside, titled "Penig i. S. Patentpapierfabrik." The scene includes multiple factory buildings with smokestacks, a tree‑covered hill in the background, and grassy foreground with a person standing near the riverbank. Printing and publisher information appears along the left and right margins in German.
